d2_answers.question: Normalize generation and profit across dry/normal/wet hydrology years.
d2_answers.fact: 2024 generation was 70.51亿kWh and attributable profit RMB218m; 2025 generation rose to 121.20亿kWh and profit to RMB600m as water inflow rose sharply. 2026 H1 profit guidance of RMB220-255m is again explicitly linked to 67.4% higher inflow.
d2_answers.interpretation: 2025 is a wet-year earnings outcome, not a safe through-cycle baseline. 2023-2025 history supports a dry/weak case around RMB220-270m and a wet case around RMB600m.
d2_answers.assumption: A through-cycle normal-water earnings band of RMB300-400m is used for valuation and dividend stress testing pending a longer basin-level hydrology series.
d2_answers.judgment: COMPLETE as a research normalization, with the normal case explicitly marked as analyst assumption.

d2_answers.question: Rebuild debt, financing-cost and maturity profile.
d2_answers.fact: At end-2025 short-term borrowings were RMB1.36bn, long-term borrowings RMB3.721bn and current portion of long-term debt RMB0.927bn, versus about RMB7.527bn across the same three buckets at end-2024. 2025 interest expense fell to RMB215m.
d2_answers.interpretation: Debt reduction was meaningful in the wet year, but financing cost remains large relative to normalized-water earnings.
d2_answers.judgment: COMPLETE. Debt service is a central earnings-normalization constraint; refinancing or leverage reversal would materially weaken the defensive case.

d2_answers.question: Quantify dividend capacity under normalized hydrology.
d2_answers.fact: 2025 total dividend was about RMB209.5m, 34.91% of wet-year profit.
d2_answers.assumption: Applying a 35-45% payout to RMB300-400m normalized earnings gives RMB105-180m sustainable annual dividends, about RMB0.25-0.42/share.
d2_answers.judgment: COMPLETE. Wet-year dividends should not be extrapolated without normalized hydrology.

d2_answers.question: Compare valuation and cash yield with 长江电力 and utility alternatives.
d2_answers.fact: Recent July 2026 market snapshots showed 黔源电力 around 13x trailing P/E and about 2.5% dividend yield, versus 长江电力 around 19x P/E and roughly 3.5% yield. 黔源's trailing multiple is flattered by exceptional wet-year profit.
d2_answers.interpretation: On normalized RMB300-400m earnings, EPS is only about RMB0.82-0.94 and the effective normalized P/E is materially higher than trailing P/E. The apparent discount to 长江电力 narrows or may disappear after hydrology normalization, while 黔源 carries higher leverage and hydrology volatility.
d2_answers.judgment: COMPLETE. Do not award a 长江电力-like quality multiple until normalized free cash flow and leverage prove durable.

d2_answers.question: Define water-level, leverage and valuation invalidation triggers.
d2_answers.judgment: Research gates: (1) normalized earnings <RMB300m without clear recovery; (2) gross financial debt reverses upward materially or interest expense stops declining; (3) dividend plus maintenance/growth capex requires re-leveraging; (4) valuation >15x normalized EPS without a lower-leverage or higher-normalized-generation case. Any trigger keeps the name out of decision-grade promotion.
